correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and quantifiers are explicit. The Q12 witness is an exact 13-shell common-denominator positive certificate. Exact Sturm variation equalities on [0,1/32], [1/32,1/3], [1/3,infinity) prove a negative Q13 shell at every real positive h; marginalization closes the infinite dimension quantifier. Taylor coefficients and shortest-walk counts prove the different short-step boundary d=6. The standalone exact rational checker reconstructed and passed 116 conditions; no finite sample substitutes for the Sturm or marginalization arguments.

value.rationale: A canonical high-dimensional Boolean diffusion problem exposes a sharp natural dimension threshold in the existence of ANY stochastic high-order Padé step, separating dimensions <=12 and >=13. It also distinguishes the smaller local positivity cutoff at six from intermediate-time feasibility through twelve. This provides a structural integrator diagnostic beyond routine per-instance arithmetic, without requiring a downstream theorem.
